video.title: AI欧腐《未竟的冬日之誓/The Unfulfilled Vow of the Winter Champion》
video.desc:
竟然是第一季
Eren, Northern Fifth Legion Commander, returns to the capital and reunites with Crown Prince Lucien, marked by the “Winter’s Mark”. A supply dispute creates strife. The buried truth of the Old City Purge shatters their romance. Tangled in political betrothals, the White Night Army and throne conflict amid court plots, haunted by past bloodshed, they grow apart yet remain linked. They fight to prove: they are no chains, but the only ones trusted with their ultimate choice.
北境第五军团统帅 Eren 重返帝都，与身负"冬印"的皇太子 Lucien 重逢。一场军需之争掀起波澜，而旧城清洗被掩埋的真相，更将两人的情愫击得粉碎。
政治联姻的纠缠、白夜军与王座的对峙、宫廷阴谋的暗涌，以及挥之不去的往日血债——他们渐行渐远，却始终彼此牵系。
他们要证明的是：彼此不是对方的枷锁，而是那个唯一可以托付最终抉择的人。
